metadata.description: Turn bathroom giggles into real science! Kids learn what poop is, how digestion works, and why color and texture matter. Includes wild animal facts (wombat cubes, parrotfish sand), toilet and TP history, and real jobs that keep communities clean. Plus a call-and-response game, a quick quiz, an original song, and a sweet mini-story about courage and that final plop. It’s silly, smart, and perfectly stinky fun!
